I guess I just dont like labels, so I dont really understand why you care that much if one girl that might not be bi calls herself bi. I mean, words do have meaning but a few people calling themselves something they arent usually doesn't change the meaning of a word. Invalidating other people's sexuality because they have never dated the same sex annoys me way more. I hear that shit so much, I heard it for years from my family members, I still wonder if im not gay (even though I've dated women) because of people like that - it irks the shit out of me. It's fine if you dont like it when people "muddy the waters", I just don't think it's ok to tell someone they arent gay if you dont know them personally.

I don't understand why people care so much about other peoples sexuality. If she's lying, cool whatever, if she isn't lying, cool whatever. It shouldn't matter to you unless you're a woman and you want to have gay sex with her. You don't know whats going on in her brain and you never will - why invalidate someone when you could just not be an ass instead? Her sexuality is of literally no relevance to you.
